shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Joy stands on the low wooden stage with her hands clasped in front of her. She rises onto her toes once, rocks back onto her heels, and answers cheerfully toward the camera, her two long braids swinging gently as she nods on the word thirty. Her pointed ears twitch upward when she smiles. After the line her lips close into a proud grin, she unclasps her hands and gives a small wave with her right hand at chest height, then clasps them again.
